data.name: Jwala
data.long_meaning: The name Jwala is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘jvala’, which means ‘a wick’, ‘a torch’, or ‘a flame’. In Hindu mythology, Jwala is the name of the Goddess of Fire, Agni. She is depicted as a fiery being with the power to consume all evil and purify the soul.
